Capabilities

Eight disciplines, delivered under one contract

Why Startbrett

We stay on site until the line runs without us

Most automation vendors hand over a panel and a manual. We hand over a running line, a trained operator, an as-built drawing set, and a phone number that a real engineer answers.

  • In-house panel shopDesign, wiring, busbar fabrication and routine testing all happen at Chakan — no third-party lead times.
  • Documentation you can auditI/O lists, loop drawings, FAT and SAT records, and version-controlled PLC source handed over on day one.
  • Safety engineered, not bolted onRisk assessment, category rating and interlock validation are part of design — not a punch-list item.
  • Retrofit without shutdownPhased migration plans that fit your maintenance window rather than demanding a fortnight of downtime.
  • Vendor-neutral by designCertified across Siemens, Rockwell, Mitsubishi, Schneider and Delta. We specify what suits your plant.

Engineering process

Five gates from enquiry to handover

Each gate has a deliverable you sign off. Nothing moves forward on a verbal agreement.

GATE 01
Site study

Plant walk-through, existing panel audit, I/O counting and constraint mapping.

GATE 02
Design & approval

GA drawings, SLD, I/O schedule and BOM issued for your review before procurement.

GATE 03
Build & FAT

Panel fabrication, wiring, logic development and factory acceptance test at Chakan.

GATE 04
Install & commission

Site installation, loop checking, dry run, SAT sign-off and operator training.

GATE 05
Support & AMC

Warranty, preventive schedule, spares holding and 24×7 breakdown response.

/About

Built by engineers who were tired of bad handovers

Startbrett was started in 2013 in a rented unit at Chakan by four automation engineers who had spent a decade inheriting other people's undocumented PLC code.

Our story

From a two-bench panel shop to a 12,000 sq ft facility

The first job was a single APFC panel for a neighbouring foundry. The second was the retrofit that foundry asked for after the panel worked. Thirteen years on, the model has not changed — we would still rather earn the next project than win a tender.

Today the Chakan facility houses a panel fabrication floor, a dedicated FAT bay where clients witness their systems running before shipment, and a software team maintaining libraries across five PLC platforms.

2013

Founded at Chakan

Four engineers, two workbenches, and one APFC panel for a foundry down the road.

2016

ISO 9001 certified

Formal quality system introduced after crossing 100 panels a year.

2018

First turnkey contract

Complete water treatment automation for a municipal client in Nashik — design through commissioning.

2021

IIoT practice launched

Energy and OEE dashboards added as a service line after clients kept asking for the data behind the SCADA.

2023

Facility expanded to 12,000 sq ft

Dedicated FAT bay, busbar fabrication and a calibration lab commissioned.

2026

1,240 projects delivered

Seventy-two engineers, forty-six cities, and a service desk that answers in under four hours.

Mission, vision, values

What we hold ourselves to

Mission

To make advanced automation practical for Indian manufacturers of every size — properly scoped, properly documented, properly supported.

Vision

A country where a mid-sized plant has the same visibility into its process as a multinational — without the multinational budget.

Values

Say the real lead time. Write the drawing before the wire. Leave the site cleaner than you found it. Answer the phone at 2 a.m.
